semiconductor_relevance: High — Sigma Technology Corporation provides specialized equipment and consumables for semiconductor manufacturing and testing, particularly in areas like IC packaging and SMT assembly.
summary: Sigma Technology Corporation offers a range of electronic manufacturing and testing equipment tailored for the semiconductor industry, focusing on innovative processes and comprehensive technical support. Their products cater to various applications, including IC packaging, circuit board assembly, and nanomaterial printing.
capabilities: Rework solutions for miniaturized SMT components
Equipment for IC packaging and assembly
Repair solutions for Flip Chip and MiniLED components

regional_presence.Taiwan: Sigma's headquarters are located in Taoyuan, Taiwan, serving as a central hub for their operations.
regional_presence.China: The company has cooperative offices in South and East China, along with on-site service engineers in Central and North China.
